lines.speaker: Old Bramble
lines.text: The Glimmerbrook arch is in full bloom. Walk in any time you fancy a replay.

lines.speaker: Old Bramble
lines.text: I keep the Rootway. Each archway opens on a different world.

lines.speaker: Old Bramble
lines.text: That one leads to Glimmerbrook Wilds. The others? Not yet...

lines.speaker: Old Bramble
lines.text: Walk into the swirling pool to travel. A tip: Plunge onto the spotted mushrooms.
